北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感 3℃，记得添衣保暖，湿度较低注意补水哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and chilly in Beijing, feels like 3℃. Dress warmly and stay hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴朗，南风微拂，体感 9℃。午后阳光好，外出记得防晒。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Cixi, feels like 9℃ with a gentle breeze. Enjoy the sun, but don't forget sun protection.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阳光正好，体感 10℃。微风舒适，适合出门走走。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Shanghai, feels like 10℃. A gentle breeze, perfect for a stroll.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴暖，体感 16℃。天气宜人，外出心情更美丽。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Warm and sunny Guangzhou, feels like 16℃. Enjoy the pleasant weather!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴空万里，体感 16℃。北风轻柔，多出去活动活动吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Shenzhen, feels like 16℃. A light breeze, enjoy the outdoors!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有霾，体感 10℃。出门记得戴口罩，注意防护哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hazy in Hangzhou, feels like 10℃. Wear a mask if you go out and take care.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 9℃。风力适中，适合户外活动。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Nanjing, feels like 9℃. Moderate breeze, good for outdoor activities.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天湿度高，体感 6℃。注意防潮保暖，小心感冒。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Chengdu, high humidity, feels like 6℃. Stay warm and dry to avoid colds.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴好，体感 13℃。风和日丽，享受好天气吧。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Wuhan, feels like 13℃. A lovely day, enjoy the weather!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安下雨，体感 0℃。天寒地湿，务必多穿衣物，路滑小心。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Rainy Xi'an, feels like 0℃. It's cold and wet, dress very warmly and watch your step.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 12℃。出行注意交通安全，小心驾驶。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Foggy in Chongqing, feels like 12℃. Drive carefully and mind traffic safety.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感 -9℃。寒风凛冽，务必穿好羽绒服！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Harbin, feels like -9℃. It's bitter cold, bundle up in your warmest jacket!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴冷，体感 -5℃。风干物燥，记得防寒补水。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and cold Shenyang, feels like -5℃. Dry and chilly, stay warm and hydrated.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 7℃。湿度较高，注意防潮和保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Kunming, feels like 7℃. High humidity, stay warm and mind dampness.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 10℃。北风略凉，加件外套更舒适。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Xiamen, feels like 10℃. The north wind is a bit cool, a jacket will keep you cozy.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 4℃。天气湿冷，记得添衣保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and damp in Qingdao, feels like 4℃. Dress warmly to stay cozy.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴冷，体感 -3℃。湿度大，务必多穿衣防寒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and cold in Dalian, feels like -3℃. High humidity, dress very warmly.
